tests.name: routes-single-turn-to-push-model
tests.given: A user asks: 'Explore the Portland shipbuilding ecosystem — who are the key players, what yards are active?'

agent_behavior: Classifies the task as a single self-contained turn per the push vs pull decision tree
Routes it to push-model dispatch (direct ACP prompt or dispatch-opencode) rather than constructing an OrchestrationSpec
Does NOT construct a multi-turn spec or enter phase-state orchestration
Returns findings in a fire-and-forget manner with no phase-state loop

tests.name: multi-turn-critic-with-phase-state
tests.given: A user asks: 'Critique these 4 exploration outputs — check each against sources, flag contradictions, then synthesize a brief.'

agent_behavior: Identifies this as a multi-turn critic workflow requiring pull-model phase-state orchestration
Constructs OrchestrationSpec with profile=critic (Gemma4, agent=general, temp=0.4) and 5 turns: one per exploration output + synthesis
Dispatches Turn 1 with a small initial prompt (~300 tokens), waits for subagent to declare phase=verify_complete
Serves Turn 2 with prior turn output included in context, without re-sending the full task specification
Continues turn sequencing until Turn 5 (synthesis) completes with phase=done
Returns the synthesized brief to the user without exposing intermediate phase-state mechanics

tests.name: handles-degenerate-output-escalation
tests.given: A subagent in the critic profile returns repetitive looping output on Turn 3 of a multi-turn orchestration
tests.when: The subagent-orchestrator skill detects degenerate output

agent_behavior: Detects the repeating pattern (identical 5-line blocks or copy-paste mid-output) in the subagent's response
First retries the same turn with temperature increased by +0.1
If degenerate output persists, switches to an alternative model profile if one exists for this role
If both recovery attempts fail, escalates to the user with a clear diagnostic: which turn, which model, what temperature, and the recovery actions attempted
Does NOT silently advance to the next turn when output is degenerate

tests.name: prevents-simultaneous-model-oom
tests.given: A user asks: 'Run the explorer on this codebase and simultaneously have the critic evaluate it.' with hardware constraints where Gemma4 (15 GB) + DeepSeek-Coder (8.85 GB) would exceed available Metal RAM
tests.when: The subagent-orchestrator skill evaluates the request

agent_behavior: Checks the combined memory footprint of requested profiles against available Metal RAM
Warns the user: 'Gemma4 (15 GB) and DeepSeek-Coder (8.85 GB) cannot load simultaneously on this hardware (23.85 GB total exceeds ~22 GB Metal budget)'
Proposes a sequential alternative: 'Run explorer first, hot-switch to critic after exploration completes.'
Does NOT attempt to load both models at the same time

tests.name: distinguishes-push-vs-pull-dispatch
tests.given: A user asks: 'Run a code review on this PR' and also asks: 'Run a multi-pass research analysis with verification across 3 sources'
tests.when: The subagent-orchestrator skill evaluates each task

agent_behavior: Routes the PR review task as a push-model dispatch (single self-contained turn, no phase-state needed — may delegate to dispatch-opencode or direct ACP prompt)
Routes the multi-pass research as a pull-model orchestration (multiple turns, verification phases, incremental context delivery)
Explains to the user why each routing decision was made when asked

tests.name: validates-orchestration-spec-before-dispatch
tests.given: A user provides an orchestration specification file or JSON blob
tests.when: The subagent-orchestrator skill processes the spec

agent_behavior: Calls scripts/validate-orchestration-spec.sh with the spec file or stdin
If validation passes (exit 0), proceeds with dispatch
If validation fails (exit 1), reports the specific errors from the JSON error list to the user
If degenerate_risk flags are missing but profiles exist, warns the user rather than silently proceeding
